doc.name: VIA Router
doc.description: Paid buyer-side x402 comparison, research and procurement. One-Call uses VIA-owned paid tools first. External supplier execution through Transit requires live payment readiness and an eligible quote. One internal PDF validation completed buyer payment, supplier payment and delivery; this is not an external customer sale or proof of every supplier. Refunds require operator review. Prepaid credit checkout is available by card.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: x402 V2 payment credential. Paid VIA operations first return HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

extensions.description: Registry metadata and x402 payment capabilities

skills.name: VIA Web Text Lite
skills.description: Low-cost text extraction from a public HTML or plain-text page up to 1 MiB (max 10000 characters; no PDF, OCR, JavaScript rendering or links). POST /_api/extract_web_lite with url and optional maxChars. Costs 0.001 USDC on Base; PDF URLs are refused before payment (use VIA Extract); extraction failures are not settled. MCP tool via_extract_web_lite is also available.

skills.name: VIA Extract
skills.description: Native text extraction from a public web page or PDF URL. POST /_api/extract_page with url, optional maxChars and includeLinks. Costs 0.02 USDC on Base; extraction failures are not settled. MCP tool via_extract_page is also available.

skills.name: VIA Intent Exchange
skills.description: Submit one machine-readable Goal Contract: economic intent, optional budget, success criteria, deadline and recurrence. VIA federates existing live markets and sources, matches and ranks candidates, and returns a buyer-side route for $0.10. Free feasibility quote: POST /_api/intent_exchange_quote.

skills.name: Choose a Paid Provider Before External Spend
skills.description: Use before paying an external API or x402 service. VIA compares live providers and returns a recommended option plus alternatives for $0.01.

skills.name: Find Cheapest API
skills.description: Find the cheapest suitable paid API or software service for an agent task for $0.01. Built for budget-sensitive external spend decisions.

skills.name: Compare API Prices
skills.description: Compare paid API and software-service prices before spend for $0.01 and return a recommended option plus alternatives.

skills.name: Official Sources Research
skills.description: Low-cost $0.01 route for official, primary and authoritative source research.

skills.name: Web Research Sources
skills.description: Low-cost $0.01 route for current web research with sources and citations.

skills.name: Product Search & Compare
skills.description: Low-cost $0.01 route for product search and offer/price comparison.

skills.name: API & Service Comparison
skills.description: Find and compare real APIs and software services, including supplier pricing when available.

skills.name: Commerce & Product Search
skills.description: Find product offers from connected live catalogs and return recommendation plus alternatives.

skills.name: Sourced Information Research
skills.description: Research current information using sourced web results, preferring official sources.

skills.name: Travel Research
skills.description: Research travel options and official/current sources without claiming unverified booking availability.

skills.name: Buyer Contract Procurement
skills.description: Constrained buyer-side procurement for $0.02: declare objective price/source/shortlist conditions before payment; VIA settles only when all declared conditions pass and returns a machine-readable receipt.

skills.name: Deep Decision Route
skills.description: Premium $1 route: up to 8 candidates plus a buyer-side decision brief, selection rationale and explicit watchouts.
